title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in PluginUs.Net…
description: A reflected Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the PluginUs.Net Active Products Tables for WooCommerce plugin, versions up to and including 2.1.8. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to execute arbitrary scripts in the context of the affected web application.
